description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'Retry' that provides mechanisms for retrying operations, particularly using the Awaitility library to wait until a supplier provides a value. It includes an inner functional interface 'ThrowingSupplier' allowing supplier methods that may throw exceptions.

classes.name: Retry
classes.description: Final utility class providing retry mechanisms based on Awaitility, including methods to retry suppliers until success.

methods.name: untilSuccess
methods.description: Retries a supplier until it provides a value, using a default or configured Awaitility condition.
